claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Sensor damage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the sensor with the lens removed, showing the surface for scratches, dust, or fungus.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or degraded

risks.risk: Lens internal damage or fungus not visible in photos
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front and rear elements, under bright light to check for haze or fungus.

risks.risk: Camera body has internal faults (e.g., shutter failure, sensor issues)
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying the image on the screen, or a close-up of the sensor with the lens removed.

risks.risk: Lens not matching the advertised specifications (e.g., not 24MP, not ISO 100-6400)
risks.proof: A photo of the lens's specification label or a test shot taken with the lens to verify image quality and sensor resolution.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially mismatched or lower quality

proof_requests: Photo of the sensor with the lens removed, showing the surface for scratches or fungus.
Close-up photo of the lens glass under bright light to check for haze or fungus.
Video or photo showing the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo of the lens's specification label or a test shot taken with the lens.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
